items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] He's got a brother by the name of Frank Tripanyay, too. Is he around?

ctx.x: And you're no relation to the drummer, you just told... No relation to whatever, no.
